PURCHASE YOUR TICKET

There are two ways to choose your two-digit number. To let the computer randomly select numbers for you, choose a Quick Pick on the vending machine or tell the cashier you want a Quick Pick at the time of your purchase.

To choose your Hi-Lo Count, go to the vending machine or tell the cashier which number you would like to select. There are no play slips for Quick Draw games.

Select a Hi-Lo Count from the following options:

0-4 Hi - 16-20 Lo
8 Hi - 12 Lo
12 Hi - 8 Lo
5 Hi - 15 Lo
9 Hi - 11 Lo
13 Hi - 7 Lo
6 Hi - 14 Lo
10 Hi - 10 Lo
14 Hi - 6 Lo
7 Hi - 13 Lo
11 Hi - 9 Lo
15 Hi - 5 Lo
16-20 Hi - 0-4 Lo

You can play up to ten times on a single ticket.

Select your wager - $1, $2, $5, $10 or $20 per play.

A wager of $1 gives you a chance to win up to $555 and a wager of $20 gives you a chance to win up to $11,100.

You can choose to play for one drawing up to fifteen consecutive drawings.

Then, your ticket will print with your Hi-Lo Count on it.

 

INCREASE YOUR PRIZES WITH SUPER BONUS

When you play Hi-Lo you can add on Super Bonus for the same cost as your base wager.

Adding Super Bonus gives you a chance to multiply your prize by 1X, 2X, 3X, 4X, or 5X. At the very end of the drawing, a multiplier will be selected and will apply to any Hi-Lo prize you win in that drawing.

 

HOW TO WIN

During the hourly drawing1, twenty numbers2 will be selected from 1 - 60; low numbers are 1 – 30 and high numbers are 31 – 60. Match the Hi-Lo Count on your ticket to the Hi-Lo Count drawn to win.

 

HOW TO CHECK WINNING NUMBERS

You can watch the hourly drawings on the Players Club app or online at ArizonaLottery.com.

You can also check your tickets by scanning them on the Players Club app or a ticket checker at an Arizona Lottery retailer.

 

ABOUT WINNING
HOW TO CLAIM YOUR WINNINGS

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.

 

HI-LO FAQS
WHAT ARE THE ODDS OF WINNING A PRIZE ON HI-LO?

Overall odds of winning a prize varies upon number of counts selected.

WHEN ARE HI-LO DRAWINGS HELD?

Drawings are held daily every 60 minutes. The first draw of the day is at 4:10 AM Arizona time and the last draw is at 11:10 PM Arizona time.

HOW OFTEN CAN I PLAY MY NUMBERS?

You can play for up to 15 consecutive drawing dates on the same ticket. Just tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or select the Multi Draw box on the vending machine.

HOW LONG DO I HAVE TO CLAIM A TWO TO WIN PRIZE?

You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim a prize. Once a ticket has expired, it cannot be redeemed even if it is a winner.

WHAT HAPPENS IF MULTIPLE PEOPLE WIN THE MAXIMUM PRIZE?

The total prize will be split into equal shares, one share for each $1.00 played. 3

WHERE DO I FIND THE DRAW ID?

Draw IDs appear on each Quick Draw ticket purchased in the bottom right-hand corner. If you purchased a ticket for more than one drawing, a range of Draw IDs will be included on the ticket. For Example: DRAW ID 10001 or, DRAW ID 10001 THRU DRAW ID 10015

 

DISCLAIMERS

1 Hi-Lo can be played from 4:00 AM to 11:59 PM Arizona time, seven days a week, with the first draw time at 4:10 AM Arizona time and the last drawing at 11:10 PM Arizona time.

2 Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

3 $55,500, prize would be pari-mutuel when the total prize for base top prize with 5X multiplier drawn is $55,500. The prize amount per winner would be recalculated when the total prize top prize with 5X multiplier is $55,500. The total prize will be split into equal shares, one share for each $1.00 played. The prize amount per share is, $55,500 divided by total winning bets. The prize amount per winner is, the prize amount per share times the bet amount.

4 All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.
